protocol.criterion: Require no trial-level known-bit error regression against preamble-only in static synthetic or libre01 training; among eligible gates minimize all training known-bit errors. Ties prefer larger drift score, larger minimum drift, larger decision gap. If no gate qualifies, retain preamble-only as the selected fallback.
protocol.limits: Only libre01 and fresh synthetic training cases. Reused held-out captures and stress cases excluded until selection/dependency freeze. No CRC/payload truth enters the receiver. Offline only.
